reconfigure.title: Change the component
reconfigure.description: Entity IDs stay the same after renaming.

component.title: Add a component to maintain
component.description: Something that needs regular care: a water filter, a vacuum brush, a car service. You will get a reminder in Repairs when it is due.

data_description.due_threshold: Days before the due date when the status becomes "due" and a reminder appears.
data_description.device_id: Optional. Shows the component on that device's page, e.g. a filter on the purifier.

menu_options.component: A component to maintain (filter, brush, service…)

battery.title: Battery monitor
battery.description: Finds every device with a battery by itself — no per-device setup — and reports low ones in Repairs. New devices are picked up automatically.

data_description.exclude_integrations: Phones, tablets and watches (mobile_app) charge every day, so they are ignored by default.

abort.already_configured: A component with this name already exists.
abort.use_options: Use Configure to change the battery monitor.
abort.battery_already_configured: The battery monitor is already set up.

battery_low.title: {name}: battery low ({level}%)
battery_low.description:
The battery of **{name}** is at {level}%. Replace or charge it soon.

The reminder disappears by itself once the level goes up.

battery_empty.description: The battery of **{name}** is at {level}% — the device has probably stopped working. Replace or charge it.

battery_low_flag.description: **{name}** reports a low battery. Replace or charge it soon.
